title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on The Nabapalli Cooperative Bank Limited, West Bengal
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated June 22, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹3 lakh (Rupees Three Lakh only) on The Nabapalli Cooperative Bank Limited, West Bengal (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Know Your Customer (KYC)’.
